name: claude-session-restore
description: A macOS window for every Claude Code chat: see what each is doing, restore them after a shutdown, steer them, and move them to a second machine.

scripts.bridge: cd vscode-bridge && bunx --bun @vscode/vsce@3 package --no-dependencies --skip-license --allow-missing-repository -o csr-bridge.vsix && code --install-extension csr-bridge.vsix --force
